messages:
jamal: quick heads-up — ran an initial bring-up for sprinter-11b with int6 vs int8 across chat (<=512) and longform (>1024) slices. putting quick numbers here, need a short recommendation for GTN (routing + default quant) so we can update the product playbook.

sara: can you drop the slice summary and the unit-cost calc? one-liners are fine.

jamal: paste below (very small sample, see full deck later)
```
SLICES: chat_short (<=256), chat_long (257-512), doc_long (>1024)
METRICS: QA_F1, halluc_rate, avg_latency_ms, tokens_per_call
int8: chat_short QA_F1=87.4, halluc=1.2%, lat=120ms, tpc=280
int6: chat_short QA_F1=86.9, halluc=1.5%, lat=95ms, tpc=280
int8: chat_long  QA_F1=84.0, halluc=2.5%, lat=180ms, tpc=980
int6: chat_long  QA_F1=82.1, halluc=4.1%, lat=140ms, tpc=980
int8: doc_long   QA_F1=81.2, halluc=3.0%, lat=230ms, tpc=2200
int6: doc_long   QA_F1=76.8, halluc=6.8%, lat=185ms, tpc=2200
COST (est): int8 = $0.028 / 1k tokens, int6 = $0.017 / 1k tokens
```

kai: quick unit econ math — per 1M tokens int8 ~ $28, int6 ~ $17 => ~39% cost reduction. throughput win looks ~1.25-1.5x depending on burst and seq len. but doc_long QA drop is non-trivial (81.2 -> 76.8).

anya: re: GTN guidance — product cares about perceived regressions on long answers. if doc_long is a small pct of traffic we can default to int6 and fallback to int8 for any low-confidence outputs (score < 0.7). propose routing flags: `sprinter11b.default_quant=int6` + `sprinter11b.fallback_on_confidence=true`

nate: worth noting we saw halluc spikes on doc_long with int6 (sampled 200 examples, halluc rate doubled+). suggested hybrid: use int6 for generation + cheap verifier run on int8 for top-1 if verifier_confidence < threshold. verifier is much cheaper because it's a short prompt.

jamal: that hybrid sounds promising. can someone estimate verifier added cost? rough calc: if 10% of calls trigger verifier and verifier avg tokens=60 -> added cost per 1M tokens: (1M * 0.1 * 60) / 1000 * int8_rate = 6k * 0.028 = $168 extra, still below int8 baseline ($28k vs int6 base $17k + verifier $168 -> big saving). numbers approximate.

eval-bot: ran a quick eval harness for the hybrid idea (small n=500). summary: precision_on_halluc reduced by 70% vs straight int6, QA_F1 recovers ~1.5-2 points on doc_long. see command used: `./eval/run_slice --model sprinter-11b:int6 --verifier sprinter-11b:int8 --slices doc_long.json --verifier-threshold 0.7`

ops-bot: capacity note — int6 lets us run ~1.8x concurrent reqs per GPU for chat_short. scheduling-wise we can roll default to int6 on hosted tiers and leave Dedicated pinned to int8 for customers who need max fidelity. will need a canary and a circuit-breaker in case halluc_rate > 5% for any 1h window.

sara: recommended short doc for GTN: 1) Default quant: int6 for chat_short and chat_long, 2) Default: hybrid-for-doc_long with verifier at 0.7, 3) Fallback: route to int8 if verifier or final_confidence < 0.6, 4) Canary: 2% traffic for 24h, monitor halluc_rate and QA_F1 deltas.

jamal: love it. action items: @anya add routing flags to the feature flags repo, @ops-bot schedule canary, @nate run verifier cost sims with n=5k, @sara write one-paragraph GTN blurb. i'll prepare the quick numbers table for marketing.

anya: added TODOs to flags board + mock flag names in PR comment.

nate: starting sim now, will post results later today.

jamal: thanks all — if we don't see major surprises in the canary we'll mark sprinter-11b int6 hybrid as "recommended for GTN: default" for PLG users and leave dedicated customers on int8 opt-in. :white_check_mark:
